title: Has anyone else had a mallworld origin dream?
content: So a few weeks ago I had a VERY vivid dream that I was at the school atached to the mall/theater and there was an announcement from the government that Pluto was rapidly hurtling towards Earth and that everyone needed to watch the skies. Since that night my mall world dreams have been more frequent and more apocalyptic than ever. Has anyone else experienced a dream similar to this?
